dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000smbl](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000smbl) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 10.0 depth occurred on Apr 03 2026 9km NE of Miyonadu. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 38.8967 longitude 70.917. It impacted 89256 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
